profile.name: Suryagarh Jaisalmer, Rajasthan
profile.badge_tooltip: Showcases sponsored, top rated vendors across budgets
profile.information:
The ideal venue for a dreamy palatial destination wedding. Suryagarh Jaisalmer sits on a threshold looking east towards the ancient city of Jaisalmer and west towards the Thar Desert whose rugged natural beauty provides venues and backdrops straight out of a royal fairy tale. The property itself is a magnificent fortress with a plethora of stately gardens and courtyards that leave you spoiled for choice while planning a dreamy palatial destination wedding. 

Space Available at Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The venue offers luxurious accommodation options for you and your guests, with well-appointed rooms and suites that are designed to provide a royal experience. The property also has a spa and wellness center for relaxation and rejuvenation. Yoga Garden and Khuzamsha Hall are both elegant indoor spaces that can accommodate up to 100-150 guests each. Both halls offer a beautiful ambiance that can be customized to suit your wedding style and preferences. With ample space and natural lighting, our indoor halls are perfect for an intimate wedding ceremony, reception or both. The Sunset Patio is a beautiful outdoor space that can accommodate up to 300-400 guests. The space is surrounded by lush greenery and offers a breathtaking view of the sunset, making it a romantic spot for your wedding ceremony or reception. If you're looking for a larger space, the Lakeside area by the pool is an ideal choice for a wedding. This space can accommodate up to 400-600 guests and offers a beautiful view of the pool and lake, creating a picturesque backdrop for your special day. With ample space and beautiful surroundings, this outdoor space is perfect for hosting your wedding ceremony and reception.

Services Offered by Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The experienced event planning team at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will work with you to meticulously plan and execute every aspect of your wedding, from venue selection to decor, entertainment, and more. They will ensure that your vision for your dream wedding comes to life. The culinary team will curate a customized menu for your wedding events, offering a delectable range of local and international cuisines. From halwai breakfasts to jazz brunches, and from Silk Route-themed sangeet dinners to indulgent after-parties, the food and beverage options at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will leave your guests craving for more. They can also arrange mesmerizing entertainers to add a touch of magic to your wedding celebrations.

Location
Suryagarh Jaisalmer is located in Kahala Phata, Sam Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. It is 7 km from the abandoned village of Kuldhara, and 15 km from the Bara Bagh temple.

Latest Pricing & Photos of Weddings at Suryagarh Jaisalmer
Add to that a host of mesmerising entertainers, unmatched service and food and beverage options to ensure that with Suryagarh Jaisalmer your destination wedding will be nothing short of extraordinary. Book them but make sure to check the Suryagarh Palace photos and reviews before making your decision. profile.name: The Marugarh Resort & Spa
profile.information:
The Marugarh Resort & Spa is an outdoor wedding venue located in beautiful city of Jodhpur, India. It is a paradise offering luxurious amenities, stunning landscapes and breathtaking views. The Resort offers an exquisite venue for wedding celebrations amidst ancient architecture, gardens and a tranquil pool. With stunning areas for the ceremony, reception, and wedding photo shoots, it is both romantic and elegant. The Resort also features a range of dining options and a signature restaurant. A team of knowledgeable and experienced staff are available to take care of every detail according to your requirements, to ensure every aspect is covered. They also boast a range of luxurious, air-conditioned suites and rooms for the perfect honeymoon or staycation. Onsite, you will also find an outdoor pool, spa, fitness centre and gorgeous gardens, guaranteed to provide the perfect backdrop for your wedding photos. The Marugarh Resort & Spa looks forward to making your special day truly dazzling, and will ensure your experience is nothing short of extraordinary.

Space available at The Marugarh Resort & Spa
The resort offers a stunning and spacious lawn area that can accommodate a large gathering of 2000 to 3000 people, making it an ideal location for hosting grand wedding celebrations. The lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is an open-air space that provides a breathtaking view of the ancient architecture and stunning landscapes. The ambiance of the lawn is both romantic and elegant, perfect for a dream wedding. The lawn is beautifully decorated with fresh flowers, lighting, and other decorations, making it look magical.

The spacious lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is designed to cater to various wedding functions such as engagement ceremonies, sangeet, mehndi, wedding ceremony, and reception. The area can be customized to suit the preferences of the bride and groom, and the professional and experienced team at the resort will ensure that every detail is covered.

Facilities at The Marugarh Resort & Spa
The Marugarh Resort & Spa provides a range of facilities and services to ensure that your wedding day is unforgettable. They take care of every aspect from minor to major. Their facilities include:

In house catering only
In house Decor
In house DJ available, Outside DJ permitted
In house alcohol available, Outside alcohol permitted
Pool, spa
63 huge rooms
In house restaurant

profile.name: Rohet Garh
profile.badge_tooltip: Showcases sponsored, top rated vendors across budgets
profile.information:
Rohet Garh is a luscious venue based in Jodhpur and is perfect for the wedding events. As you pass through their towering fort gates, you’re instantly transported back in time. Built in 1622, this haveli retains much of its original charm and architecture. It has remained in the same family for the past 15 generations serving the past and the present.
If you’re dreaming of a wedding that eschews cold granite and glass in favor of history, where the walls whisper tales of valor and the gardens murmur of bygone romances, then House of Rohet is the place for you. 
If that was not enough - House of Rohet organises unique experiences that may be hard to find anywhere else- you can have your Mehendi curated as a Royal picnic on the banks of a serene lake or a cocktail amidst a shikar dinner setting where the canopy is a sky full of stars,  the bar is a Roeda tree and the only illumination is through the soft glow of a hundred  flickering flames.

Space available and capacity
With 3 uniquely designed Properties—House of Rohet offers 30-50 rooms in close vicinity of each other making it an ideal location for intimate weddings and mile stone celebrations having groups of 60-125 pax

Cuisines available
The kitchens are filled with royal recipes passed down through generations, the venues provide different settings and the rich local heritage provide myriad options ready to make your celebration truly unforgettable.
Equipped with world-class facilities, the venue is spacious and comfortable. They offer complete event support for all your nuptial ceremonies and events. With their class apart services, you are ensured that every experience with them is unique, every time. This venue is an ideal choice for your wedding events as it can hold lavish as well as a simple and subtle functions.
Vibrant and progressive, Hotel Rohet Garh retains the warmth and spirit of India. The services go far above and beyond the conventional venue and catering staples. All these services would be customised according to your demands, needs, and budget.
Let them  host your special day and weave it into our rich tapestry of traditions, stories, and folklore.^

vendors.name: Radisson Jodhpur
vendors.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)
On-site SVA Spa, open 09:00-21:00, gymnasium open 06:00-22:00
24-hour airport transfer

Established in 2023, this eco-friendly resort offers a serene ambiance combined with modern amenities, ensuring a memorable experience for your special day.  

Space Available and Capacity at Dream Connect Resort
The resort features a spacious outdoor area, accommodating up to 150 guests, making it perfect for weddings, engagements, cocktail parties, and other medium-sized gatherings. It also allows intimate Pre-wedding events with a guest count of less than 50. The venue includes 10 well-furnished rooms, providing convenient accommodation for out-of-town guests and the wedding family.  

Cuisines at Dream Connect Resort
The resort is a vegetarian-only venue, making it an excellent choice for religious events or vegetarian weddings. The in-house catering team offers a variety of delicious and thoughtfully curated dishes to delight your guests.

Outside decorators permitted for customized décor  
in-house catering services ensuring high-quality food

Location of Dream Connect Resort
The resort is situated 10.6 km from Jodhpur Railway Station and is easily accessible via NH 62. Its convenient location, combined with excellent facilities, makes it a popular choice for weddings and celebrations in Jodhpur.

On The Farm (OTF) in Jodhpur is an enchanting open-air farmhouse-style wedding venue that perfectly captures authentic Rajasthani vibes for your special day. This beautiful wedding lawn offers couples a unique rustic charm combined with traditional elegance, making it an ideal choice for memorable wedding celebrations. Located conveniently in Jodhpur, this venue is perfect for anyone seeking a distinctive wedding location in and around Air Force Area and Cantt Area, providing easy accessibility for guests while maintaining its serene farmhouse atmosphere.

Space Available at On The Farm (OTF)
The venue offers a spacious outdoor setting perfect for various wedding ceremonies and celebrations:

Outdoor Lawn - Ideal for wedding ceremonies, reception parties, and pre-wedding functions with a seating capacity of 500 guests and floating capacity of 550 guests


Why you should choose this venue
On The Farm (OTF) stands out as an exceptional wedding destination with its authentic Rajasthani farmhouse ambiance that creates magical memories. The expansive outdoor lawn provides ample space for large gatherings while maintaining an intimate, rustic charm that's perfect for both traditional and contemporary wedding celebrations.

Planning your wedding budget is crucial, and On The Farm (OTF) offers competitive pricing packages for different wedding requirements. On The Farm (OTF) is conveniently located just 6.7 km from Jodhpur Railway Station, making it easily accessible for outstation guests. The venue's strategic location in Jodhpur ensures smooth transportation while offering the perfect blend of accessibility and tranquil farmhouse setting for your wedding celebrations.

vendors.name: Radisson Jodhpur
vendors.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)

24-hour airport transfer

Perfect for your wedding celebrations, they offer a plethora of services and high quality amenities. Making your celebrations even better, they offer a pure vegetarian catering service prepared by experienced chefs with the provision of in-house bar. With all this, they also offer décor and design services and DJ entertainment services to make your celebrations joyous. To top it up, they also have a stunning outdoor area with swimming pool where the bride and groom can spend some romantic moments.

menuDetails.name: Radisson Jodhpur
menuDetails.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)
On-site SVA Spa, open 09:00-21:00, gymnasium open 06:00-22:00
24-hour airport transfer
